issues.reason: The word "other" is itself what puts the contrast anchor there, so *Core patterns*' point-at-the-words test is met; dropping the restriction instead would widen the claim to "wraiths rise from no water at all", which *Core patterns* forbids ("a stated restriction ... is never silently dropped"), and once the anchor is used in the guard, the bar on untyped referent symbols in *Names and casing* makes (Member sk_water_1 water) mandatory rather than an over-assertion.

gaps_confirmed: Contrastive anaphoric "other" restricting a quantified range ("no other water"): the instruction set has no treatment of "other", so the excluded antecedent has no licensed carrier.

A negative quantifier on a non-subject argument ("rise from no other water"): the negated-generic and "none of the" patterns both quantify the subject, and nothing prescribes how "no" on an oblique's object maps onto the rule form.
new_gaps: A presupposed-but-unmentioned referent - the excluded antecedent that "other" implies - has no licensed carrier: the projection rules (denial bundles, seals, definites) all cover only referents the sentence actually mentions, so nothing states whether such an anchor may be minted at all, or at what strength/confidence its typing atom should sit given that the sentence only presupposes it.
notes: The anchor witness is load-bearing: without it the Compute distinctness guard has nothing to exclude and the "other" restriction cannot be carried. The strength-0.0 two-universal rule, the single "no" QuantifierPhrase companion, Source for "rise from", and the absence of any positive rise-from-sk_water_1 claim are all sound.
